findings.title: Journal search with an apostrophe crashes the API (search term pasted into SQL)
findings.expected: Searching O'Brien lists the entry "Met O'Brien at the fence"
findings.actual: GET /api/journal?q=O%27Brien answers 500 Internal Server Error (the q term is put into the LIKE clause with an f-string in backend/routers/journal.py); the page shows only 'Could not load the journal.' and the matching entry can never be found
